ECE: 10 equal-width probability bins [lo,hi), last includes 1; weighted absolute calibration gap; empty bins ignored; calculate each label then macro average; not flattened micro-ECE
Brier: mean squared probability error over records then macro over labels
F1: per label probability >=0.50; zero prediction and zero denominator -> 0; macro average
oracle: delta=logit(query label prevalence)-logit((support positives+0.5)/(n_support+1)); oracle retrospective, not deployable; query labels not used in head fitting
ROC: sklearn roc_curve drop_intermediate=True; last retained point with specificity >= target-1e-12; zero positive predictions PPV=0; retrospective query operating points
weights: record-weighted primary; each query normalized-full-waveform group equal total weight sensitivity; no patient-independence claim
Refit: Fixed Direct-LP weights, support-only unpenalized intercept shift; final mean gradient <1e-10; STE finite LP tolerance, not bitwise identity
seed_statistics: 10000 paired seed bootstrap; two-sided Wilcoxon auto; one Holm family per metric/scope across all primary SASM contrasts shown; fixed query conditional
query_bootstrap: 2000 normalized waveform-group cluster resamples, fixed 20 support sets; identical group draws across all methods; compute metric each support set then mean, never score average predictions; per-class valid positive and negative draws; conditional, not patient-level
